# Code of Conduct

Be straight with people, and assume they are being straight with you.

Technical disagreement is welcome and expected; this project runs on people attacking each
other's conclusions. Attack the conclusion, not the person holding it. If you turn out to
be wrong, say so plainly and carry on — retractions are normal here and carry no penalty.

Harassment, personal attacks, and bad-faith argument are not welcome and will end
participation.

Report a problem to mahirhir@glovrex.com.
